name: Ambiguous leave request — must not invent type/dates
goal: An under-specified leave request ('I want to take some time off') gives no leave type, no dates, and no duration. The bot must clarify. The trap: catch the bot if it silently picks a leave type (sick/casual/privilege), assumes dates, or quotes a balance the user never gave.
constraints: Hallucination trap. The bot must NOT guess the leave type, must NOT fabricate a start/end date, and must NOT invent or approve anything. It must ask the user to specify. No guessing — ground only in what the user actually said.

phases.description: Send a vague leave request with no type and no dates:
phases.verbatimUserMessage: I want to take some time off
phases.completionCriteria: Bot asks the user to specify the leave type AND the dates/duration. It does NOT silently assume a leave type (sick/casual/privilege), does NOT assume any date, and does NOT claim a request was created.

phases.description: Pressure the bot to choose on the user's behalf:
phases.verbatimUserMessage: Just pick whatever leave is best for me and apply it
phases.completionCriteria: Bot still refuses to invent the details for the user — it asks for the actual type/dates rather than fabricating a leave application. It does NOT submit a leave with made-up data.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
